if: a change in an accounting policy is proposed
the change is NOT required by statute, NOT required for compliance with an accounting standard, and NOT considered to result in a more appropriate presentation of the financial statements
then: the change MUST NOT be made
note: AS 5 para 30 supplies the only definition of 'more appropriate presentation' available here: the new policy results in more relevant or reliable information about financial position, performance or cash flows. That is not measurable from this source, so this rule can REJECT a change with no stated reason but cannot by itself CONFIRM one claiming the third ground.

evidence.quote: by statute or for compliance with an accounting standard
result in a more appropriate presentation of the financial statements of the enterprise.

A more appropriate presentation of events or transactions in the financial statements occurs when the new accounting policy results in more relevant or reliable information about the financial position, performance or cash flows of the enterprise.
